name: Dendritic spine maintenance and postsynaptic membrane organization
rationale: All members regulate the upkeep of dendritic spines and postsynaptic membrane, whereas confusables cover spine morphogenesis, postsynaptic actin, dendrite arborization and plasticity.

name: Platelet activation and cytoskeletal remodeling expression signatures
rationale: Members are transcriptional modules for platelet activation and cytoskeletal remodeling, distinct from confusables on fibronectin matrix, integrin/Rap1 signaling and SRF-target stress fiber programmes.

name: Neurofascin/NrCAM-driven voltage-gated sodium channel clustering
rationale: Members describe L1-family adhesion molecules neurofascin and NrCAM and the sodium channel clustering they organize, which distinguishes them from DSCAM/nectin adhesion, axon regeneration and myelination confusables.

name: Renal and aldosterone-responsive sodium-potassium transport regulation
rationale: Members regulate Na+/K+ transmembrane transport in renal and aldosterone/potassium-response contexts, unlike confusables centred on osmotic stress, chloride transport or glomerular blood-pressure control.

core: Amino acid and cholinergic neurotransmitter turnover
name: Amino acid and cholinergic neurotransmitter turnover, including clostridial neurotoxins
rationale: Members cover synthesis, release, reuptake and receptor action of GABA, glutamate, glycine and acetylcholine plus botulinum/tetanus toxicity at cholinergic synapses, unlike the monoamine confusable and confusables lacking the cholinergic/toxin arm.

name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium cycling in cardiac contraction and relaxation
rationale: Members concern SR calcium ATPase regulation, calcium sequestration and release controlling cardiac force and relaxation, distinct from confusables on heart rate, chemical inotropy and sodium/calcium exchange.

qualifier: Tfh help and plasma cell differentiation
name: Germinal centre Tfh help and plasma cell differentiation
rationale: Members span Tfh differentiation, ICOS co-stimulation, germinal centre B cells, memory B cells and immunoglobulin-secreting plasma cells, unlike confusables on naive B cell signatures and early B cell activation.

name: RNA virus genome replication and host translation subversion
rationale: Members describe influenza, coronavirus and RSV RNA synthesis, RNP assembly and hijacking of host translation and antiviral sensors, unlike confusables dominated by HIV reverse transcription/integration and HCMV.

name: BRCA1-PALB2-BRCA2-dependent homologous recombination strand exchange and defects
rationale: Members cover presynaptic RAD51 strand exchange, SDSA D-loop resolution and their BRCA1/PALB2/BRCA2 loss-of-function defects, distinct from confusables on end resection, SSA, MMEJ and NHEJ.

name: Glycosaminoglycan and O-mannose/O-fucose glycan synthesis, with congenital defects
rationale: Members cover proteoglycan GAG chain synthesis, dystroglycan O-mannosylation, Notch/TSR O-fucose/O-glucose glycosylation and their inherited enzyme defects, unlike confusables on N-glycans/mucin glycans, GAG degradation and muscle development.

Members mix PRPP, creatine, inositol and fructose metabolism, mitochondrial ATP/ADP transport, magnesium homeostasis, protein oligomerization and calcium-independent adhesion with no shared biological process.

qualifier: lateral plate mesoderm and hindgut morphogenesis
name: Gastrulation mesoderm migration, lateral plate mesoderm and hindgut morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover mesendoderm and mesodermal cell migration at gastrulation, lateral plate mesoderm formation and hindgut/digestive tract morphogenesis, unlike confusables on primitive streak, definitive endoderm and foregut.

name: FLT3 and oncogenic fusion kinase signaling with CBL regulation
rationale: Members describe FLT3 and FLT3/FGFR1 fusion signaling to STAT5 and SRC kinases with CBL-mediated negative regulation, distinct from interleukin, PDGFR mutant, TKI-resistance and EPO/TPO confusables.

name: Neutrophil respiratory burst, degranulation and microbial killing
rationale: Members concern ROS/respiratory burst, degranulation and neutrophil killing of bacteria and fungi, unlike confusables on neutrophil chemotaxis/formyl peptide receptors, macrophage programmes and antimicrobial proteins.

name: CCT/TRiC chaperonin folding of actin and tubulin
rationale: Members describe prefoldin-assisted CCT/TRiC folding of actin and tubulin, distinct from confusables on general de novo folding, aggrephagy, ER folding and G-beta folding.

qualifier: V-ATPase and carbonic anhydrase-driven, Golgi and lysosome
name: V-ATPase and carbonic anhydrase-driven Golgi and lysosomal acidification
rationale: Members cover V-ATPase assembly, proton transport, CO2 hydration and Golgi/lysosomal pH reduction, unlike confusables on lysosomal pH elevation, bicarbonate transporters, pigmentation and phospholipid scrambling.

name: Receptor tyrosine kinase autophosphorylation and ERK1/2 activation
rationale: Members share receptor tyrosine autophosphorylation feeding downstream ERK1/2 signaling, distinct from confusables on PDGFR regulation, PI3K/AKT and FGFR PI3K/PLC cascades.

qualifier: respiratory chain assembly and iron-sulfur cluster biogenesis
name: Respiratory chain assembly, oxidative phosphorylation and iron-sulfur cluster biogenesis
rationale: Members cover electron transport, complex I-IV and ATP synthase assembly, chemiosmotic ATP synthesis and Fe-S cluster assembly, unlike confusables on mitochondrial protein import, cristae, proteolysis and heme synthesis.

name: Megakaryocyte-erythroid lineage differentiation and platelet formation
rationale: Members span megakaryocyte development, platelet morphogenesis and erythroid-megakaryocytic and terminal erythroid signatures, unlike confusables limited to erythrocyte differentiation or RUNX1/myeloid progenitor programmes.

qualifier: calcineurin-NFAT-linked hypertrophy, atrophy and fiber type
name: Calcineurin-NFAT-linked striated muscle hypertrophy, atrophy and fiber-type adaptation
rationale: Members concern muscle growth, atrophy, cell size, fiber-type transition and calcineurin-NFAT signaling in muscle adaptation, distinct from confusables on cardiac contraction, cardiac regeneration and neuronal calcineurin.

name: Signal recognition particle-mediated protein delivery to endoplasmic reticulum
rationale: All members concern SRP-dependent cotranslational targeting of proteins to the ER, distinct from confusables on COPI/COPII vesicle traffic, Golgi budding and ribosome rescue.

qualifier: splicing, snRNA biogenesis, 3'-end processing and export
name: Spliceosome, snRNA biogenesis, mRNA 3'-end processing and nuclear export
rationale: Members cover splicing, snRNP/snRNA production, polyadenylation and histone mRNA processing and mRNA export, unlike confusables on rRNA/Pol I-III transcription, exosome decay and cytoplasmic mRNA decay.

name: Nuclear receptor transcriptional control of adipogenesis and lipid-glucose metabolism
rationale: Members describe PPAR, LXR, ROR/REV-ERB, SREBP and PGC-1alpha transcriptional control of white/brown fat differentiation and lipid and glucose metabolism, unlike confusables on lipid droplet enzymology, ChREBP sugar signaling and thermogenesis.

name: Striated muscle size adaptation and cardiomyocyte proliferation/regeneration
rationale: Members cover hypertrophy, atrophy, fiber-type and calcineurin-NFAT adaptation plus cardiomyocyte proliferation and regeneration, distinct from confusables on myogenesis, myoblast differentiation and sarcomere contraction.

qualifier: error-prone, by REV1, POLI and POLK
name: Error-prone translesion DNA synthesis by REV1, POLI and POLK
rationale: Members describe PCNA-mediated damage recognition and error-prone bypass by REV1, Pol iota and Pol kappa, distinct from the error-free POLH confusable and replication or excision-repair gap filling.
